New bugs gather behind the front line. Every 18 seconds both waves clash. Before each clash pick a tactic (Z Charge, X Hold, C Flank): Charge beats Flank, Flank beats Hold, Hold beats Charge, and the enemy's pick is only revealed when the waves meet. Win a clash and the front moves one mark toward their nest; win at their door and you storm it. Survivors come home and fight again. Every bug has a role: ■ walkers beat ● ranged, ● ranged beat ▲ flyers, ▲ flyers beat ■ walkers. Watch what the enemy gathers and build against it. Hatch units with the cards (or keys 1 to 6); each class deploys in its own way (ant squads, beetle pupae, scorpion ambushes and more). Click a disaster card, then click the battlefield where it should strike (keys Q, W, E...). Height matters: flyers dive down to bite and land to rest when they tire, and that is when walkers can reach them. Ants climb into ladders, crickets pounce, and tall bugs (scorpion tails, bombardier spray, beetle horns) reach low flyers.
